predecessorChecks.note: P.1-SYM --check runs P.1A-SYM --check, which requires P.1C, P.1D, P.1E and 3F.6-T-SYM to reproduce byte for byte

historicalW.router: none trained: W measured information with a binary logistic model (NEXUS-best vs RESOURCE-best) and a diagnostic multinomial; its enriched contract is the only routing artefact

historicalSelectionReplay.rule: usable without imputation, not structurally redundant, mean held-fold delta >= 0.005 (historical W)

W1_ROUTER_ERRORS_CONCENTRATE_IN_THREAT_S.historical: frozen 3F.6-T router CAL error ratio HIGH_HOSTILE 2.04, UNCOVERED_THREAT 1.88, BOTTLENECK 2.05

W2_THREAT_STRUCTURE_ALREADY_IN_CORE.historical: threat-structure fields had no DEV increment (mean delta <= 0)

W8_NEXUS_CAPTURE_FAILS_DESPITE_SIGNAL.historical: missed NEXUS was the largest router error class (588 of 848 CAL errors)

historical.risk.coveredThreatCount: identical to the CORE identity relational.threatenedEntityCount - relational.uncoveredThreatenedCount

W11_LEAK_FREE_DECISION_TIME.historical: risk fields read the observation packet and legal surface only

W12_NO_ROUTING_GAIN.historical: result B: no router retrain (routerRetrainReadyIf A)

W13_FALSE_SELECTION_HARM_UNCHANGED.historical: enrichment was not expected to change false-selection harm

disclosures.PRIVILEGED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: priv.* features read kernel entity positions no interface exposes; they appear only in diagnostic models and never in a headline router
disclosures.SPATIAL_IS_ABSOLUTE_FRAME: the historical W spatial diagnostic reads absolute actor x/y, which a D4 twin changes; any value it carries is orientation-bound
disclosures.TARGETS_ARE_LABELS: every risk target is computed from oracle regret or optimality and is used only as a label, never as an input
disclosures.SEED_FAMILY_SAMPLES: seed-family rows (2021, 2022, 2023, 3021) were generated and used by earlier stages; they are diagnostic here, never confirmatory
disclosures.TRANSITIVE_PREDECESSORS: P.1-SYM --check reproduces byte for byte only when P.1A-SYM, P.1C, P.1D, P.1E and 3F.6-T-SYM do
disclosures.LATENCY_NOT_HASHED: wall-clock timings are printed to the console and are not part of the certificate
